decisions.reason: As a certified HVAC plate heat exchanger line close to the core portfolio, it matches the firm's efficiency-driven strategy and is likely to remain even if recent website visibility was lower.

The marine cooling unit still fits the firm's marine thermal-management capabilities, but the earlier withdrawal of another marine product makes this niche line more exposed to portfolio rationalization.
The compact oil cooler serves broad industrial machinery applications and strengthens the established heat-exchanger offer, so it is more likely to be retained than discontinued.

Finned tubes support both equipment sales and lifecycle service business, though as a more component-like offering they carry a somewhat higher risk of being folded into other activities rather than pushed as a standalone line.
Enhanced heat exchanger tubes align well with the firm's R&D orientation and customer demand for higher efficiency, making continuation the more probable choice.
